about: The Collect of the Fifth Sunday after Epiphany in the 1962 Roman Missal, also used when its formulary is resumed after Pentecost. The proper pages print the body and short Per Dominum cue. The full conclusion and Amen are a separate RG115a expansion with declared house orthography.

seg.tr: Lord, we beseech You, guard Your household with continual loving-kindness, so that it, relying solely on the hope of heavenly grace, may always be guarded by Your protection. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: Guard Your household, we beseech You, Lord, with continual loving-kindness
relies solely on the hope of heavenly grace,
may always be guarded by Your protection
